preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The initial cleaning level X and the target cleaning level Y are both absolute values less than or equal to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rounds to achieve the target cleaning level.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the minimum number of operations required to change X to Y using the given operations
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of operations required to change the initial cleaning level X to the target cleaning level Y using the operations of adding a and subtracting b.
